prose: Bloomberg reports that AI infrastructure company Accelevation and backer Olympus raised $540 million in a US IPO, selling 30 million shares at $18 each - below the marketed $20-$24 range. The pricing suggests investor caution toward data-center infrastructure offerings. (Summary based on the Techmeme headline and feed excerpt; the full article could not be retrieved.)
